title: Aerated Peppery Algerian Fish Tagine
description: Spicy and aromatic, this fish tagine is infused with the brightness of Algerian cuisine, featuring a rich fish sauce and delicate peppercorns. The aerated texture from steaming adds a unique twist to this traditional North African dish.
instructions: Heat the oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the sliced onion and cook, stirring occasionally, until softened and caramelized, about 15 minutes.
Add the garlic, cumin, smoked paprika, black peppercorns, and white peppercorns; cook, stirring constantly, for 1 minute.
Add the fish sauce, fish pieces, and lemon juice; stir to combine.
Transfer the Dutch oven to a large steamer basket and steam the mixture for 8-10 minutes or until the fish is cooked through.
Stir in the honey and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve immediately, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
